title: Ruins of the Dwarven Forge
description: Half-buried in hardened lava flow, the remains of an ancient dwarven forge jut from the scorched earth. The anvil still stands, cracked but intact, and the forge pit glows faintly — as if the mountain itself keeps the coals alive. Scattered tools, warped ingots, and the skeletons of long-dead smiths litter the workshop floor.

choices.label: Salvage the forge tools
choices.description: Pry loose intact tools and materials from the ancient workshop.

outcomes.text: A masterwork tong and several usable ingots survive beneath a collapsed beam. Dwarven steel holds up even after centuries.
Most tools have fused to the stone, but you pry a few salvageable pieces free. Better than nothing.
A beam collapses as you pull at the tools, sending a shower of hot coals across the floor. You scramble clear, singed but alive.

choices.label: Rekindle the forge
choices.description: Feed fuel into the ancient forge pit and see if the dwarven enchantments still hold.

outcomes.text: The forge roars to life with a sound like thunder! Ancient runes blaze along the anvil. The magical heat tempers your gear and mends your wounds.
The coals catch and the forge pit fills with steady heat. Not as powerful as it once was, but the warmth feels restorative.
The forge detonates! Ancient wards, weakened by time, discharge in a blast of fire and shrapnel. The ruin collapses inward — but a few heated ingots tumble free.

choices.label: Search the fallen smiths
choices.description: The dead may still carry valuables from a more prosperous age.

outcomes.text: One skeleton clutches a pouch of fire opals, preserved by the heat. Another wears a ring fused to bone — priceless drake scale inlay.
A few coins and a vial of preserved drakeblood sit in a leather satchel, remarkably intact despite the heat.
As you disturb the bones, something stirs in the forge pit. Embers coalesce into a shape — the forge guardian still watches over its masters.
